target.title: feat(webui): redesign tool-call rendering with inline diffs, group summaries, and cheap-model purpose titles
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #103554.

Tool calls in the Control UI chat were opaque: groups collapsed to "Activity: N tools", expanded calls dumped raw "Tool input"/"Tool output" JSON, file edits had no diff view, and shell commands had no terminal presentation. Two pairing bugs made it worse: transcript results whose call id lives on the message (not the block) rendered as a second bare "Tool" row, and parallel calls (call, call, result, result) never paired because coalescing was adjacent-only.

## Why This Change Was Made

Requested redesign toward coding-agent-style activity rendering: scannable verb-first rows, inline diffs, and cheap-model purpose titles so long sessions read like a work log instead of a JSON dump.

## User Impact

- **Kind-aware rows**: `$ command` with display-only syntax highlighting (harness `sh -lc '…'` wrappers stripped), `Edited protocol.md +2 -1` with colored diffstat, `Read file.ts`, `Wrote new-file.ts +14`, `Searched pattern`, plus a `failed` badge on errors.
- **Inline diffs**: edits render the edit tool's persisted `details.diff` (real file line numbers) as add/remove tinted rows; foreign-harness edits (`old_string`/`new_string`, Codex `apply_patch`) fall back to a locally computed bounded line diff; writes show an all-added preview. Raw output stays behind the existing "Raw details" toggle.
- **Group summaries**: consecutive calls collapse into a bordered card labeled e.g. "Ran 13 commands, read 6 files, edited 9 files, created a file · 1 failed"; while a run is live the newest running call names the group and running rows pulse.
- **AI purpose titles**: complex calls (long commands, argument-heavy plugin/MCP tools) get short titles like "Ran linked list tests" through the new batched `chat.toolTitles` RPC. Model selection is cheap-only: per-agent/default `utilityModel` when configured, else `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` — and the Luna default applies only when the agent's primary model already routes to OpenAI, so tool arguments never reach a provider the session was not already using. Titles never fall through to the expensive primary model. Titles cache in the per-agent SQLite `cache_entries` (scope `tool-call-titles`), so reopening sessions never re-bills. If no cheap model is usable the RPC returns nothing and rows keep deterministic labels.
- **Pairing fixes**: result blocks now inherit the call id/name/details at merge time, and results pair with any open call in the current tool run (bounded window), so parallel calls render as single rows.
- Generic tools with simple object args render key–value rows instead of a JSON block; reads/searches no longer repeat their args as JSON.

New protocol surface is additive: `chat.toolTitles` (params/result schemas + validator), registered with `operator.write` scope because cache misses spend utility-model tokens.

### Before / After

| Before | After (light) | After (dark) |
|---|---|---|
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/tool-calls-redesign/before-expanded.png) | ![after light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/tool-calls-redesign/after-group-light.png) | ![after dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/tool-calls-redesign/after-group-dark.png) |

Collapsed before: ![before collapsed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/tool-calls-redesign/before-collapsed.png)

Live gateway session (real run, gpt-5.5, real `chat.toolTitles` round-trip producing "Ran linked list tests"):

![live collapsed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/tool-calls-redesign/live-collapsed.png)
![live expanded](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/tool-calls-redesign/live-expanded-titles.png)
![live running](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/tool-calls-redesign/live-running.png)

## Evidence

- Unit/DOM tests: 281 tests across 8 affected files green on Blacksmith Testbox (new: `tool-call-diff.test.ts`, `tool-call-view.test.ts`, `tool-call-grouping.test.ts`, `tool-titles.test.ts`, `src/gateway/chat-tool-titles.test.ts`; updated: `chat-tool-cards.test.ts`, `chat-message.test.ts`, `chat-thread.test.ts` incl. new interleaved-pair and user-boundary regressions). Testbox run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29077207952
- Targeted e2e `ui/src/e2e/chat-tool-turn-outcome.e2e.test.ts` green with a strengthened semantic assertion (error row keeps error class after a later turn recovers).
- `pnpm check:changed` green on Testbox (`exit=0`: conflict/changelog/dependency guards, typecheck core, typecheck core tests, lint core). The last few review-fix commits after that run are covered by local focused tests + scoped oxlint; PR CI reruns the full gates.
- Structured second-model review (Codex `gpt-5.5`, branch mode vs `origin/main`) ran through 11 rounds; every accepted finding was fixed (NUL-byte source file, unbounded patch parsing, Luna egress gating to OpenAI-primary agents, split-pane session/agent/client capture for title batches, stale view cache on late diff details, lit-guard repaint for arriving titles, live-vs-historical running state, streaming-output completion, arg auditability on expand). Final run: "autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings". One finding was consciously rejected: per-run provider provenance for titles on sessions whose primary later switched to OpenAI — the full transcript flows to the new provider on the next turn anyway, so a decorative-title-only gate would not change real egress.
- Live proof: isolated dev gateway (`OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` copy, port 19789) ran a real multi-tool coding task twice; screenshots above show unwrapped commands, merged parallel reads, group summaries, and a real Luna-generated title ("Ran linked list tests") arriving via `chat.toolTitles` and rendering on the command row.
- Docs updated: `docs/gateway/protocol.md` (`chat.toolTitles`), `docs/web/control-ui.md` (tool rendering + titles).
